name: Paper Form
summary: A deadpan bureaucratic paper form: typewritten as it is spoken, ticked and struck with an orange marker, and slammed with a distressed rubber stamp.
suits: a light breather inside a dark video

palette.use: paper: bone × 0.965 in linear light, darkened up to ~6.5% by fibres
the header band (ink at 94% over paper)
ink: type, box outlines, rules, arrows
graphite: box notes, fine print, the printed grid (at 3.5%)
ash: empty checkboxes, dotted answer lines, unchosen options (proposed)
signal: typing heat, ticks, crosses, the marker strike, the stamp
blood: proposed-row numbers, chosen answers, totals on the good row
header text on the ink band

type.case: spaced caps for labels, sentence case for typed answers
type.emphasis: a signal tick, a blood answer, or the stamp

banned: a light-blue grid or ruled lines (off-palette): the printed grid is graphite at 3.5%
a dark halo or shadow behind captions on paper
rounded friendly UI: boxes are square hairlines, the form is bureaucratic
more than one stamp per form
colour other than ink, graphite, ash, signal and blood on the page
handwriting fonts or emoji ticks: ticks and crosses are drawn strokes
a cheerful tone: the form is deadpan; the joke is in the content
